stop_rules: Budget consumed once when execution starts. Failure does not authorize rerun, code edits or network changes. Submit exact findings. Formal Dataset remains not started even if future V3 PASS; Formal Start requires separate changeset.

binding_execution_rules.G4: aggTrade >0 AND diff_depth >0 required; either zero or no valid live stream => FAIL. forceOrder zero alone allowed with observable lifecycle.
binding_execution_rules.fail_fast: Direct G1 or G4/G5 blocker: STOP; no reruns or later expensive runs. Unexecuted gates NOT_RUN_DUE_PRIOR_BLOCKER, never implied PASS.
binding_execution_rules.G6: Exactly one real worker stop/relaunch; pre<=180s, interruption30s, post<=180s, total<=420s. Prior checkpoint evidence only, fresh initialization and persisted snapshot, explicit discontinuity provenance, no restored fake HEALTHY/book, resumed acquisition.
binding_execution_rules.carry_forward: G2/G3/G7 source/manifest bindings only, no historical experiments. G3 coverage gap explicit.
binding_execution_rules.source_freeze: After first evidence invocation any source edit invalidates rebind: STOP, separate bounded fix required, never reuse prior evidence after patch.
binding_execution_rules.V3: Mechanical gates and G8, explicit readiness/formal_dataset_start_allowed/blockers; V1 historical FAIL and V2 pre-Day1 PASS preserved; V3 binds c59ad33d8694c9f5a33bcb0432ff6fb1b721f629 and immutable once finalized.
